parole.significato: tea (in all senses: the drink, the plant, the dried leaves, or tea-drinking)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish چای (çay), from Chinese 茶 (chá). The “tip” sense derives from the expression дава́ть на чай (davátʹ na čaj) / дать на чай (datʹ na čaj) (literally, “to give [some money] for tea”).
